why: creates an explicit `/rosout` publisher (`rcl_interfaces/msg/Log`, absolute topic) on a node; NULL QoS takes the bounded VOLATILE profile. Since phase-556 W13 the executor creates that publisher itself, as rcl does, for every node in its table (`rclc_executor_node_init`); this call is for a LEGACY `rclc_node_init_default` node, which is not, and on a bound node it adds a second publisher. Part of the `/rosout` bridge from C (issue 1589, `<rclc/rosout.h>`). Links in every image and answers `RCL_RET_UNSUPPORTED` without the `rosout` capability.
